 HONOR Play 20A will be released with a special promo exclusively on Shopee
 HONOR's new budget smartphone will be part of the 11.11 Sale!
 By Nicolo Manaloto - November 5, 2026 Fresh after announcing its 11.11 sale , HONOR Philippines has now revealed the exclusive Shopee promo for the new HONOR Play 20A .
 To be exact, HONOR will offer the Play 20A first, exclusively as part of the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale on November 11. While the phone has an SRP of PHP 8,999, during the promo on the 11th, buyers will be able to get it at a special price of PHP 8,099. What’s more, buyers can get the phone for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months via a 0% installment plan with SPayLater.
 This makes it a great deal for budget-conscious buyers and those looking for an extra phone. That’s because the Play 20A has some unique features for a budget phone, including an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that lets users check notifications, control media, and take selfies with the main shooter. It also features a 90Hz refresh rate screen and a 6,000mAh battery.n
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features,” said Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. “Through our exclusive Shopee availability this 11.11, customers can take advantage of special pricing, vouchers, and flexible payment options, making it easier to experience a smartphone designed for their everyday needs.”
 While the HONOR Play 20A will be available exclusively on Shopee on November 11, its official PH release date is November 28, 2026.
